titleTr: Collocations: make / do, take / have (günlük işler)

explainTr: Collocation, bazı kelimelerin birlikte doğal duran eşleşmesidir. Türkçede hepsi 'yapmak' olan şeyleri İngilizce ayırır: do homework (ödev yapmak) ama make a mistake (hata yapmak).

'Do' çoğunlukla iş, görev ve genel faaliyetler için kullanılır: do the dishes, do the laundry, do a favor, do your best. 'Make' ise bir şey üretmek ya da ortaya çıkarmak için: make a decision, make a phone call, make an effort, make a mess, make money.

'Take' alınan, yapılan eylemlerle gelir: take a break, take notes, take a shower, take a bus, take a chance. 'Have' ise yemek, deneyim ve durumlarla: have lunch, have a conversation, have a problem, have fun, have a headache. Bunları tek tek ezberlemek yerine çiftler hâlinde öğren.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'yapmak' çoğu şeye uyar: ödev yapmak, hata yapmak, karar vermek. İngilizcede 'make a decision' (karar vermek), 'do homework' (ödev yapmak) gibi her isim kendi fiilini ister; 'do a mistake' veya 'make homework' hata sayılır.

reading.title: Hafsa's busy Saturday
reading.text:
Saturday is Hafsa's busiest day, but it is also her favorite. It is the one day when she does not have to hurry to class or to an appointment, so she can take care of everything at her own pace.

She begins at seven o'clock by making a cup of Turkish tea and taking a few minutes for herself on the balcony. Then she makes a to-do list. Today, it has five errands: do the laundry, make a phone call to the school district, have lunch with her neighbor Linda, buy groceries, and help her son Emre with his science project.

At eight, Emre comes into the kitchen with his hair standing up. "Mom, I made a mistake," he says. "I forgot that the deadline for my project is Monday, not next week." Hafsa laughs and makes a plan. "Do your best, and take it step by step. We will do it together this afternoon." This is a habit she has developed: she does not scold, but she makes a suggestion, and the problem seems smaller at once.

The phone call takes longer than expected. The district office puts her on hold twice, but she makes an effort to stay calm and speak clearly. In the end, she makes an appointment for a training session, and she writes the date in her notebook right away. She feels proud.

At noon she has lunch with Linda at the little café near the park. They have a long conversation about their children and about the new bus route. Linda tells her about a bargain at the grocery store, so Hafsa takes the shortcut through the park on the way home and buys fruit for the week.

Back at home, she and Emre do the science project. They take photos of the plants, take notes about the results, and make a poster. Emre makes a mess with the glue, but nobody minds. When it is finally finished, Hafsa takes a short nap on the sofa. "Today I made a difference in my own life," she thinks, "even if it was only a small one."

script.speaker: Hafsa

script.text: Of course. I will take the car, and we can have lunch near the park.

script.speaker: Emre
script.text: Perfect. I need to do some research for my history homework.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Good. Then we have a plan. Let's both make an effort to finish early.

script.speaker: Emre
script.text: Deal. I will start with the laundry right now.

writing.promptTr: Bir günlük programını ya da hafta sonu işlerini anlat (120-180 kelime). En az altı collocation kullan (do the laundry, make a decision, take a break, have lunch, make an effort...).
writing.promptEn: Describe a busy day or a weekend when you had many things to do. Write 120-180 words and use at least six collocations with make, do, take or have.
frames: First, I did the ... / I made ...
Then I took a break and had ...
writing.model: Last Saturday was one of my busiest days, but I managed everything. In the morning, I did the laundry and cleaned the kitchen. Then I made a phone call to the school office, because I needed to make an appointment for a training session. After that, I took the bus downtown to buy groceries. On my way, I made a quick decision to visit my neighbor Linda, and we had lunch together at a small café. We had a long conversation about our children and the new school rules. In the afternoon, I helped my son Emre with his science project. He made a mess with the glue, but we finished on time. I took a short nap and then did my English homework. I made a few mistakes, but I made an effort to correct them. In the evening, I took a long shower, and I felt tired but happy. It was a good day.
checklistTr: En az altı collocation kullandın mı (make/do/take/have)?
'Do homework' ve 'make a mistake' gibi ayrımları doğru yaptın mı?
Geçmiş zaman fiillerini doğru kullandın mı (did, made, took, had)?
Cümleleri sırayla (first, then, after that) bağladın mı?
